description: Surface a page-level cancel/stop control on the generic (agent-launch) session detail page by wiring the existing, tested cancel path into the page header. Web-only change; no backend/runner changes.

tasks.title: Refine useCancelGenericSession to report honest cancel outcomes
tasks.description: Fix the existing dead-UI hook's misleading toast in entities/agent/api/agent-sessions.ts: refine useCancelGenericSession.onSuccess to branch on data.state so a 'cancelled'/terminal state emits a success toast while a 'not-cancellable' outcome (no live ACP session or agent ignored cancel) emits a warning toast and still invalidates the ['agent-session', projectId, sessionId] queries (which prefix-covers both summary and transcript). Update the hook's existing unit tests in agent-sessions.test.ts to assert both branches plus query invalidation. This makes the data/API layer honest before the UI consumes it, satisfying the 'Non-terminal outcome is surfaced honestly' scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: useCancelGenericSession.onSuccess inspects data.state instead of unconditionally firing a success toast
A 'cancelled' or terminal state emits a success toast ('Session cancelled')
A 'not-cancellable' state emits an honest warning toast (no fabricated success) and still invalidates session queries
Both branches invalidate the ['agent-session', projectId, sessionId] query prefix so summary and transcript refetch
onError remains the network/5xx path and is unchanged
agent-sessions.test.ts unit tests cover the cancelled, terminal, and not-cancellable branches and pass
tasks.notes: Design D4. Mandatory, not optional polish: the hook fires its toast before the page can intercept, so honesty must be fixed at the hook. Query invalidation already prefix-matches both summary and transcript queries (verified against TanStack Query semantics).

tasks.title: Surface page-level cancel control on the generic session detail page
tasks.description: Wire the existing cancel mutation into the generic session page. Extend the shared SessionDataSourceResult (pages/session/data/SessionDataSource.ts) with an optional cancel: { mutate; isPending } | null field (D1); populate it in useGenericSessionDataSource (wrapping the fixed useCancelGenericSession) and return cancel: null from useIssueSessionDataSource so the shell structurally cannot render a control on issue/workflow routes. Render a destructive cancel trigger inside SessionHeader, gated by cancel != null && isRunning (D2), that opens the existing shared AlertDialog in destructive tone whose onConfirm calls cancel.mutate() and whose loading binds to cancel.isPending (D3); the trigger only opens the dialog and never calls mutate directly. Extend GenericSessionPage.test.tsx with cancel-control visibility (running vs terminal), the confirmation gate (no request before confirm; dismiss sends nothing), mutation invocation on confirm, query invalidation on success, and add a regression guard that the issue/workflow SessionPage route renders no cancel control.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionDataSourceResult exposes an optional nullable cancel: { mutate: () => void; isPending: boolean } | null
useGenericSessionDataSource returns a populated cancel object; useIssueSessionDataSource returns cancel: null
Generic session page header renders the cancel control only when cancel != null && isRunning, and never inside the followup composer
Activating the trigger opens a destructive-toned AlertDialog; no cancel request is sent before explicit confirmation
Dismissing the dialog sends no request and leaves the session running; confirming calls cancel.mutate() (POST .../agent-sessions/{sessionId}/cancel)
Control is hidden/disabled once the session reaches completed/failed/cancelled/stopped (isRunning === false)
AlertDialog confirm button reflects cancel.isPending (dismissing disabled while in flight)
Issue/workflow SessionPage route renders no cancel/stop control in header or composer (regression test passes)

GenericSessionPage.test.tsx covers visibility, confirmation gate, mutation invocation, terminal hiding, and query invalidation; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: Updated SessionDataSource.ts type, useGenericSessionDataSource, useIssueSessionDataSource, SessionHeader/SessionDetailShell cancel control + AlertDialog, and extended GenericSessionPage.test.tsx + issue/workflow regression guard
tasks.notes: Design D1+D2+D3. Reuse isRunning from the data source (canonical non-terminal signal shared with the followup composer) so cancel visibility and composer enablement stay in lockstep. Reuse @/shared/ui/components/alert-dialog (destructive tone) per IssueCommentsSection pattern — do not add a new confirm primitive. The runner's existing not-cancellable guard for non-generic targets (runner-signalr.ts) is the backend backstop and needs no change.
